name: Cloudinary Media
description: Image and video hosting with Cloudinary — on-the-fly transformations, AI-powered optimization, and CDN delivery.
postInstallNotes:
1. Use `uploadImage(filePath, { folder: 'avatars' })` to upload images.
2. Use `getImageUrl(publicId, { width: 400, height: 400 })` to generate optimized transformation URLs — no storage duplication.
3. For direct browser uploads, generate signed upload presets in the Cloudinary dashboard.
